dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a shallow concave curvature transitioning from the basal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's maximum vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin presents a smooth convex arc at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Basal width to maximum vertical height ratio is approximately 1.6:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon profile defined by a medium-radius arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum visible in profile, extending anteriorly from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced attenuation of the caudal peduncle proximal to the fluke.
